text:
kai_support: Customer Nimbus Labs paid via bank transfer but payment has no invoice ref or PO in remittance field. They're blocked from provisioning — amount $12,450.00 USD, value date 2025-07-25. Can finance reconcile without an invoice ref? @emma_finance

emma_finance: Can you attach the bank copy or MT103 excerpt and the bank's transaction reference (TRN/SWIFT field 20/21/70)? Also need the exact value date/time. If there's a TRN we can try matching.

kai_support: Uploaded the payment confirmation PDF (see link in ticket). Bank shows TRN 987654321 on their side but the sender left the remittance field blank. Customer says their PO is PO-9987 but that's not on the transfer memo.

oliver_sales: Customer insists PO-9987 exists in their AP system; they emailed it. VAT: GB customer, but invoice was issued in USD (no VAT on invoice). Could VAT mismatch prevent auto-match?

billing-bot: Invoice: https://redwood/app/invoices/INV-2025-0773 | Amount: 12450.00 USD | VAT: none.

emma_finance: VAT shouldn't block reconciliation if amount and value date match. Primary keys for auto-match are: bank trace (TRN) or invoice number in remittance. If neither present, fallback is amount+value-date within tolerance.

kai_support: Customer AP sent an MT103 excerpt. field 70 (remittance) empty, field 20: TRN1239876, ordering bank ref "ORD-ACCT-55". Pasting excerpt:

```
:20:TRN1239876
:23B:CRED
:32A:250725USD12450,00
:50K:/12345678
JOHN DOE CORP
:59:/987654321
NIMBUS LABS
:70:
:71A:SHA
```

emma_finance: Thanks. I'll search ledger for TRN1239876 and ORD-ACCT-55. If found we can manually apply to INV-2025-0773. If not, we need a stamped beneficiary bank statement showing value date + amount (bank letter) or ask their bank to provide the trace (STA/tracing ref).

marta_ops: Quick reminder: for Dedicated contracts we require PO in the invoice metadata — can Sales lock this as a checklist item to avoid repeats.

emma_finance: Found a match using the trace number TRN1239876 + value date 2025-07-25. Manually applied payment to INV-2025-0773, reactivated the account. Note: manual reconciliation performed 2025-07-25 15:12 UTC. Left audit note with bank trace and uploaded MT103.

kai_support: Confirmed with customer — access restored. Customer asked for guidance to avoid future delays: include invoice number and PO (if any) in the beneficiary/reference field when instructing bank, or attach remittance advice. :thumbsup:

emma_finance: Recommended template to send to customers:

"Please include the invoice number (INV-2025-0773) and your PO (PO-9987) in the beneficiary/reference or remittance field of the bank transfer. If your bank cannot include it, please provide a stamped MT103 or bank statement with the payment trace."

kai_support: Thanks — closing the loop on the ticket.
